 Order

Dated this the 18th day of September, 2023 This is a petition filed under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, seeking pre-arrest bail and the petitioner is the 1st accused in Crime No.390/2021 of Vanitha police station, Pathanamthitta where the prosecution alleges commission of offence punishable under Sections 498A of the IPC, Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1861 and Section 75 of the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015.

At the time of hearing the learned Public Prosecutor submitted that the FIR in this crime has been quashed as per order in Crl.M.C. No. 3406/2022.
In view of the above submission, the apprehension of arrest at the instance of the petitioner doesn't survive.
Accordingly, this bail application stands dismissed.
